case_results.evidence: Validation rejects missing URLs, invalid schemes, and empty event_types; valid payloads pass.
WebhookEventType.fromWire accepts only instance.started, instance.completed, instance.errored, task.activated, and task.completed.
Route authorization returns 403 for non-PLATFORM_ADMIN callers and allows admin callers through.
Dispatch body builder emits the stable envelope fields event_type, instance_id, timestamp, and payload.
Dispatch headers include content-type, x-bpm-event-type, x-bpm-delivery-id, x-bpm-attempt, and x-trace-id.
Signature helper formats output as sha256=<hex> for a non-empty secret.
Signature header is omitted when no secret is configured.
Retry delay logic is exponential and capped across attempts 1..5.
Failure classification pauses the subscription when the 5-attempt budget is exhausted.
Audit payload shape for create/delete preserves the expected before/after state semantics.
HTTP 2xx responses with invalid or non-JSON bodies are treated as delivery success.
Retry counters are isolated per subscription for the same source event.
Admin create subscription returned 201 and persisted ACTIVE, max_attempts=5 row state.
GET subscriptions is admin-only and redacts stored secret values.
DELETE subscription is admin-only, returns 204 for existing rows, and removes the row.
Matching lifecycle events fan out and deliver the expected JSON body and delivery headers.
Signed deliveries include x-bpm-signature and unsigned deliveries omit it.
Non-2xx failures retry with at-least-once semantics and update next_attempt_at.
Fifth consecutive failure pauses the subscription and marks the delivery exhausted.
Create/delete operations write the expected OBS-03 audit rows atomically.
HTTP 2xx with invalid/non-JSON response body is treated as success without retry.
Fan-out to multiple subscriptions keeps retry counters independent.
